name: github-manager
description: Audit and strengthen any GitHub account: profile fields, profile README, repo descriptions, topics, license, project READMEs and release workflows. Read-only audit first, every write confirmed.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and strengthen your GitHub repos and profile
interface.longDescription: Runs a read-only health audit of a GitHub account or a single repo (profile fields, profile README, descriptions, topics, license, README structure), then fixes what you approve: account fields, a generated or hand-written profile README, repo metadata, standardized project READMEs with optional translated mirrors, and tag-driven release workflows for npm, NuGet, PyPI, Go, MCP servers and agent plugins. Preferences live in one config file shared by Claude Code and Codex.
defaultPrompt: Audit the README in this repo
Check my GitHub profile and repo descriptions
